content.text: Clear evidence: io-pay (third-party, IO Payments Ltd) started returning 503s at the onset, causing io-shop's error rate and latency to spike. No deploys/changes preceded this, and rollout is converged (single revision), ruling out bad-deployment / config / compat-break causes.

hypotheses.subject: api.io-pay.example
hypotheses.summary: api.io-pay.example (IO Payments Ltd, third-party) began returning 503 errors for card retrieval calls at the account page, and io-shop's error rate and latency spiked in lockstep since the payment provider call is made while rendering that page.

supporting_evidence.claim: ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - PaymentProviderFailed: api.io-pay.example returned 503 for /v1/shoppers/shopper-3815-1-0/card at src/io_shop/payment_provider.py:95
WARN io-shop: account page error rate at 100.00% over the last minute
io-pay: third-party, owned by IO Payments Ltd, at api.io-pay.example - Holds the card Io charges. Called while the account page renders
Deployment of io-shop has converged: all 3 replicas are running the same revision.

error_rate rises from 0.01 to 0.29 then to 1.0 exactly at onset, with p50/p95/p99 latency jumping from ~45/215/380ms to ~2045/2220/2385ms in the same minutes, while request_volume and cpu_used_cores stay flat
